description: iHydroSlide3D couples distributed hydrology with three-dimensional slope-stability calculations. Guoding Chen and collaborators provide the MATLAB implementation and a manual through its own repository. The model propagates rainfall and soil-moisture conditions into streamflow, factors of safety, failure probabilities and landslide geometry. It supports hydrological and geotechnical grids at different resolutions, with configured domains, not fixed worldwide input coverage. These outputs can inform flood and landslide exposure for infrastructure corridors. The public code is free under the Unlicense and documents parallel execution on Linux and Windows. A limitation is that the repository now states that version 1.0 is no longer maintained and directs users to a successor. The paper-linked Zenodo code archive has restricted access, while the inspected GitHub repository remains public. Separate figure data and plotting scripts accompany the publication. No matching catalogue resource was identified, and no model run or MATLAB installation was attempted.
